title: The Elf Next Door Is Sloppy!
description: Elves are supposed to be an elegant, wise, and noble race closest to God. Or so I had always believed and admired... until Elcia-san, the tenant right next door at my apartment, turned out to be a hopeless, booze-soaked slob living in a trash-filled room?! "I refuse to acknowledge an elf like this!" Can he successfully rehabilitate her, not into a decent human, but into a true, proper elf...?!
author: Moyuru
